criteria.text: Production, development, rollback, and legacy deploy entrypoints acquire one shared non-blocking host lock before any Docker, Nginx, or service mutation; a concurrent operation exits nonzero without running its command.

A generic infrastructure wrapper holds the same lock for the full child-command lifetime, identifies the requested operation without exposing secrets, and releases the kernel lock automatically when the process exits.

The deployment workflow ships the lock helper to the host, changes to the helper trigger deployment, and focused contention tests, deploy contract tests, type-check, and build pass without SSH, deploy, access, secret, migration, reindex, or paid work.
